changeSet.author: local-chinese-edition
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.specimen_intake_decision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_specimen_intake_ids CHECK ( id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND sample_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND patient_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND request_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND sample_item_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND created_by BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_specimen_intake_operation CHECK (operation_id ~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_specimen_intake_reason CHECK ( (decision = 'ACCEPTED' AND reason_namespace IS NULL AND reason_id IS NULL AND reason_version IS NULL AND reason_label IS NULL) OR (decision = 'REJECTED' AND reason_namespace IS NOT NULL AND reason_namespace IN ('DICTIONARY:resultRejectionReasons', 'QA_EVENT') AND reason_id IS NOT NULL AND reason_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND reason_version IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason_version)) > 0 AND reason_label IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason_label)) > 0)), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_specimen_intake_evidence CHECK ( length(evidence_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 AND evidence_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$');

rollback.sql: DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Specimen decision downgrade requires an authorized evidence-preserving migration'; END $$;
